title: Priority radar for growth-led accounts (tier + ICP + deployment + region)
content:
Purpose:
Lightweight, sortable sheet to drive QBR prioritization and renewal triage for growth-led accounts. Combine four lenses: commercial tiering, ICP fit, deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private), and region. Output = ranked list + playbook action per account for the next 30/90 days.

Instructions (how to use quickly):
- Copy this sheet into your QBR workbook, filter for your book of business.
- Sort by Renewal Risk Score (descending) then by ARR to find high-impact, high-risk accounts.
- Use columns H/I (Suggested Cadence / Playbook) to pick a template before outreach.
- Add owner and next-touch date to keep tasks actionable.

Column headers (A -> M):
A: Account Name
B: Net ARR (USD)
C: Commercial Tier (S/M/L/Strategic)
D: ICP Fit (0-5) (0 poor -> 5 ideal)
E: Deployment Mode (Hosted | Dedicated | Private)
F: Region (NA | EU | APAC | LATAM)
G: Usage Signal (MAU pct change / 30d) (number)
H: Tech Risk (0-5) (infra blockers, private network issues, integrations missing)
I: Renewal Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
J: Renewal Lead Time (days) = Renewal Date - today (sheet calc)
K: Risk Weighting Notes (short text)
L: Renewal Risk Score (0-100) -> computed (see rubric below)
M: Suggested QBR Cadence + Primary Playbook Action
N: Next Owner
O: Next Touch Date
P: Notes / Smoking Guns / Links

Scoring rubric (quick, intended to be fast):
- Weighted inputs: ARR (30%), ICP Fit (25%), Usage Signal (15%), Tech Risk (15%), Renewal Lead Time (15%).
- Normalize each input to 0-100 before weighting. Examples:
  - ARR norm: log-scale buckets (0-100). >1M -> 100, 250k-1M -> 75, 50k-250k -> 45, <50k -> 15.
  - ICP Fit: multiply 20 (0-5 -> 0-100).
  - Usage Signal: increase if negative trend (ex: -30% -> 100 risk contribution; +20% -> 0).
  - Tech Risk: multiply 20 (0-5 -> 0-100).
  - Renewal Lead Time: <=30 days -> 100, 31-90 -> 60, 91-180 -> 30, >180 -> 5.

Example compute: renewal_risk_score = round(ARR_norm*0.3 + ICP_norm*0.25 + Usage_norm*0.15 + Tech_norm*0.15 + LeadTime_norm*0.15)

Priority buckets (for operations):
- Red (80-100): immediate outreach + executive sponsor + technical urgent sync. QBR cadence: 2 weeks pre-renewal check-in + 1:1 exec.
- Orange (60-79): outreach within 30 days, tailored adoption plan, cost/placement review. QBR cadence: 30 days.
- Yellow (40-59): monitor signals, proactive enablement, suggested 60-90 day cadence.
- Green (<40): standard renewal track, automated comms and quarterly business review.

Sample rows (mock data to illustrate usage):
1) Acme Retail | 1,250,000 | Strategic | 5 | Private | NA | -2% | 1 | 2026-03-15 | 32 | "heavy infra, slow rollout" | 86 | "2wk cadence, exec sponsor + infra war room" | "Ethan Brooks" | 2026-02-25 | "PRD link: confluence/ACME-integration, jira: INT-88"
2) BrightHealth AI | 420,000 | Large | 4 | Dedicated | EU | +12% | 2 | 2026-06-20 | 137 | "good fit, SSO outstanding" | 54 | "30d cadence, SSO + billing review" | "Priya Nair" | 2026-03-05 | "Waiting on SOC2 cert; legal engaged"
3) FinWise Labs | 95,000 | Medium | 2 | Hosted | NA | -28% | 4 | 2026-04-10 | 56 | "usage dropping; cost concerns" | 78 | "2wk cadence, adoption playbook + pricing review" | "Noah Rivera" | 2026-02-22 | "Running A/B on prompt templates; churn risk"
4) EduSpark Global | 32,000 | Small | 3 | Hosted | APAC | +5% | 1 | 2026-09-01 | 191 | "pilot stage" | 22 | "standard cadence QBR 90d, upsell nurture" | "Ava Lawson" | 2026-05-01 | "Pilot contract through Aug 2026"

Playbook snippets (to copy into CS playbook library):
- Exec Rescue (Red): 1) Schedule 30m exec sync, 2) Triage infra + assign SRE/solutions lead, 3) Offer 90-day targeted capacity buffer, 4) Open billing concessions dialog if warranted.
- Adoption Sprint (Orange): 1) 2-week enablement sprint, 2) Dedicated solutions review for integration gaps, 3) Weekly adoption dashboard emails, 4) Suggest optimization (caching / batching) with Redwood Optimize pilot.
- Tech Calm (Yellow): 1) Weekly health check with engineering, 2) Template-driven enablement email, 3) Deploy quick wins from playbook (prompts, evals).
- Standard Renewal (Green): 1) Automated usage summary 30d before renew, 2) Template QBR deck, 3) Quarterly check-in.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Should we surface quantization/cost-savings potential in the sheet? (helps renewals for high-cost hosted customers)
- Add a column to capture "policy + compliance risk" for on-prem/private customers (GDPR / SOC2 delays).
- Build a filter view for "next 90 days renewals" and an automated Slack digest for Red/Orange accounts.
- Owner: can we add a small lookup to map AE -> CSM for auto-assign? Jira: JIRA-3421 (task).

Quick links and templates to paste into QBR:
- Exec Rescue template (confluence): confluence.redwood/exec-rescue-template
- Adoption Sprint checklist (doc): drive/redwood/adoption-sprint-checklist
- Cost reduction assessment (sheet): drive/redwood/cost-assessment-template

Version/history (light):
- 2025-11-03 initial draft by Ava Lawson
- 2025-12-18 applied ARR bucket feedback from finance (Noah)
- 2026-01-09 added sample rows + playbook snippets (Priya)
- 2026-02-18 flagged as living doc / cleaned up scoring notes

Bottom line: this is a pragmatic, sortable sheet to help CS teams prioritize QBRs and renewal outreach with a repeatable scoring model. Keep it simple, iterate with sales and finance, and automate the Slack digest once the filter views stabilize.
